name: convo-v4-wealth-advisor
description: Wealth-advisor demo: the v4 chat turn and portfolio lookup workflows exposed as MCP tools by the Orkes MCP Gateway.

tools.name: ask_wealth_advisor
tools.description: Ask the wealth-advisor assistant a question. Pass sessionId and prevExecutionId from the previous answer to continue the chat.

sessionId.description: Chat id (any UUID); reuse it for every turn of one chat

prevExecutionId.description: executionId returned by the previous turn, empty on turn 1

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Look up a client's portfolio (holdings, total value, YTD return) by full name, e.g. 'Jane Doe'.
